author: wittjosiah
principle: Construct an object with its initial data in one call rather than creating it empty and mutating it immediately after.
fix_shape: pass the initial values into the factory function instead of assigning them via a follow-up mutation call.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Write a story for the lowest-level component that needs it, rather than adding integration dependencies (client/database) to a story that doesn't actually use them.
fix_shape: target the plain component in the story; reserve client/database/plugin-manager dependencies for container-level stories that need them.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A package's vitest config must include the storybook project when the package has stories, or its story tests never run.
fix_shape: add storybook: true to the createConfig call.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A shared runtime library that must stay a single instance across host and plugin (e.g. effect) belongs in devDependencies+peerDependencies, not a regular dependency.
fix_shape: move the dependency to peerDependencies (and devDependencies for local build/dev).

author: wittjosiah
principle: Keep domain/business logic out of a `types` directory; that directory should hold schema/type definitions only.
fix_shape: move logic functions to a separate module apart from the schema definitions.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Keep list entries such as registered plugins in alphabetical order.
fix_shape: insert the new entry in alphabetical position.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A shared/common module must not import from higher-level, non-common modules.
fix_shape: move the shared code into the common module or invert the import so common has no dependency on non-common code.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a type's module/file/namespace after the entity it exports, not an unrelated project name.
fix_shape: rename the file and namespace export to match the exported object's name.

author: richburdon
principle: Do not repeat the plugin/package name in a component's name when the surrounding namespace already implies it; name the component for its role instead.
fix_shape: rename the component to a role-based name without the redundant prefix.

author: richburdon
principle: Import from a directory's barrel (index) rather than reaching into a specific file within it.
fix_shape: import the symbol from the parent barrel instead of the individual component file.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A barrel/index file should re-export only from within its own subtree, not reach up into parent directories.
fix_shape: move the re-exports so the index only imports from inside its own directory tree.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When adding a new resource type that resembles an existing one, follow the established implementation pattern (icon annotations, feed usage, etc.) already used by similar types instead of diverging.
fix_shape: add the icon annotation and align the new type's implementation with the existing analogous plugin's approach.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Place a new HTML entrypoint alongside an app's other entrypoints and name it consistently with them, rather than putting it in a new location with a bespoke name.
fix_shape: move the file to the standard entrypoint location and rename it to match convention.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a function must stay internal-only, say so in its doc comment rather than renaming it away from its established name.
fix_shape: add a doc comment noting internal-API status and keep the original name.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not include changes unrelated to the PR's stated purpose in the diff.
fix_shape: drop the unrelated edit from the diff.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Type a field that holds a DXN as the DXN string type, not a bare string.
fix_shape: use the DXN string branded type instead of `string` for DXN-valued fields.

author: richburdon
principle: Use the design system's structural primitives (e.g. Dialog.Header/Dialog.Body) for a dialog's title and content instead of laying it out ad hoc, so padding and clipping stay consistent.
fix_shape: wrap the title and body content in the appropriate primitive components.

author: richburdon
principle: Combine a guard condition and the value it guards into a single derived expression instead of checking the condition and separately re-deriving the value later.
fix_shape: merge the boolean check and the value lookup into one guarded assignment.

author: richburdon
principle: Use JSDoc-style /** */ comments for documentation, not // line comments.
fix_shape: convert the // comment to a /** */ block comment.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reference the owning domain object via a typed Ref rather than passing around a derived low-level identifier like a queue DXN.
fix_shape: change the signature to accept a Ref to the domain object instead of a DXN the caller must derive.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Cache expensive per-key resources (like sessions) inside the service that owns them rather than recreating one on every call.
fix_shape: add a cache keyed by id/dxn inside the service and reuse existing sessions instead of constructing new ones each call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Fix the underlying types so an `as any` cast isn't needed, rather than casting to silence the type-checker.
fix_shape: adjust the type signatures/generics until the cast is unnecessary.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a top-level import statement instead of an inline `import('module').Type` type reference.
fix_shape: add a normal import line and reference the type by name.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When you remove a package's last consumer of a shared catalog dependency, also remove that dependency from the catalog.
fix_shape: check other packages for usage and delete the unused catalog entry too.

author: wittjosiah
principle: An in-repo @dxos package dependency must use workspace:* (or workspace:^ for peers), not a fixed semver range.
fix_shape: replace the pinned version with workspace:*.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a story's default render component DefaultStory, matching the project's storybook naming convention.
fix_shape: rename the component to DefaultStory.

author: richburdon
principle: Don't wrap a component in a container element that one of its children already provides.
fix_shape: remove the redundant wrapper and rely on the child's own wrapping.
